description: Northeast Conservation Planning Atlas is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Conservation Biology Institute. This free science-based mapping and analysis platform gives users a way to view, retrieve, and perform analyses on spatial information with specific conservation goals in mind. It is built on Data Basin, a science-based platform that supports learning, research, and sustainable environmental stewardship. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
